manufacturer.name: Overhead Door
manufacturer.note: US garage door and operator manufacturer. Serves its manuals from its own Azure CDN at overheaddoor-production-assets.azureedge.net; that host and the owner-manuals index are both registered as harvest targets. Several independent Overhead Door dealers mirror the same manuals, and those are recorded as distributor sources rather than as separate documents.

documents.title: Legacy 650 (Model 1029) and Legacy 850 (Model 2029) Owner's Manual
documents.evidence: On overheaddoor-production-assets.azureedge.net, Overhead Door's own CDN - a manufacturer host despite the azureedge.net address, same reasoning as Rytec's S3 bucket. The model numbers 1029 and 2029 come from the search result's rendering of the document's own cover. The sfvrsn query parameter is the CMS cache-buster and may change; if the link later breaks, the owner-manuals index is the route back in. Not fetched - egress blocked.
